job_description: This is an hybrid position. Working onsite at our Dallas station located at: 12114 S Pipeline Rd, Euless, TX 76040 and 1 day a week you will be able to work from home. In an era where travel is synonymous with freedom and adventure, the allure of hitting the open road has never been stronger. With 90+ rental locations in Europe and North America, roadsurfer is your RV rental expert and outdoor adventure partner. Come join us as we ride the #roadsurfer wave in Dallas. Why surf the wave with roadsurfer? Become part of the #roadsurferfamily and work in a company culture where you are part of an open, fast-growing team with ambitious goals and positive team spirit. We stick together and combine a brutal hands-on mentality with fun at work! It means shaping the future of outdoor travel and building an ecosystem for sustainable outdoor travel. The role – your passion Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Personalized Customer Assistance: You serve as the initial point of contact for roadsurfer prospects and customers, offering tailored guidance on our product offerings. Respond to customer's inquiries via phone and email offering top notch service to every customer. Provide detailed information regarding RV rentals, services and accessories. Answer before adventure questions to guide the customer through the booking process. First-Level-Support: You professionally and effectively handle issues such as damage claims, breakdowns, ensuring prompt solutions and overcoming objectives. Assist customers in troubleshooting issues with RVs and related equipment. Provide fast solutions and recommendations based on the customers' needs. Manage customer objectives with empathy and efficiency. Work closely with the stations to offer customer-related support and offer a high-level customer experience. CRM/Booking Management: Your responsibilities include coordinating existing bookings and subscriptions, whether it's for updates, changes, or cancellations. Utilize Ticketing/Phone CRM system to manage customer interactions and track inquiries effectively. Process booking changes and cancellations with proper notation and follow-up. Use of Microsoft Suites to connect with your team and organization. Team Collaboration: You collaborate closely with other teams, such as product development, our international stations, and the sales team, to maximize service quality. Collaborate with the Customer Success department in house and international to resolve complex issues to ensure customer satisfaction. Work closely with the Supervisor regarding escalations. Work with other departments to ensure cohesive customer experience. What you need to surf the wave with us: You embrace our Core Values: Free Hugs - We're open, optimistic and always have each other's back. Trustety - We trust each other and speak openly and honestly. Fully Hands On - We're pragmatic and get the right things done. Customer At Heart - We put our customer at the heart of everything we do. Own Your Ship - We take responsibility and strive for excellence. 2 years' minimum customer service experience. Inbound/Outbound call experience desired. Strong written/verbal communication skills; able to read, write and speak English to interact effectively with a global customer base. Multilingual is a plus! Quick problem solving and troubleshooting techniques. Knowledge of Zendesk or a similar CRM system is a plus. Proficient in Microsoft Suite (Teams, Outlook, Excel etc.) Tech Savvy. Fast learner and strong attention to detail. Open availability to meet business needs which include nights, weekends and some holidays. Customer service experience in a car dealership, car rental and/or U-Haul industry is a plus. Your cheerful attitude shines through, the ability to WOW our customers! You truly enjoy camping, travel, road trips, and exploring far-off places. Able to work independently & experience working remotely. This is an hourly non-exempt role. The hourly rate is $17-$20 per hour.

Director of Sales. Department: Sales. Reports To: General Manager. FLSA: Exempt. Job Summary: The Director of Sales is responsible for overseeing the sales and marketing strategies for a select-service hotel. The primary goal is to drive occupancy rates, grow existing accounts, and attract new business to maximize revenue and meet or exceed profit goals. This position manages the day-to-day operations of the hotel sales department, including direct sales efforts, follow-ups, and administrative duties, as well as team training. Additionally, the Director will develop sales forecasts, marketing strategies, advertising campaigns, and annual budgets for the hotel, ensuring activities remain within approved budgets. Management-level associates are expected to work as much of each workday as is necessary to complete their job responsibilities. Education & Experience: A minimum of 6 years of progressive experience in hotel sales, or a 4-year degree with at least 2 years of relevant experience, or a 2-year degree with at least 4 years of related experience. A valid driver's license is required. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential for negotiating, persuading, selling, and influencing other management personnel, hotel guests, and corporate clients. Strong proficiency in professional selling techniques, including opening, probing, supporting, and closing sales. Strong analytical and strategic skills for effective sales deployment. Proficient in general computer skills, particularly with Microsoft Office products. Ability to work independently while managing multiple tasks. Strong organizational and presentation abilities. Proven capability to work with people from diverse backgrounds and solve complex problems while fostering a productive sales environment. Advanced knowledge of sales, marketing, and hospitality principles and practices. Job Duties & Functions: Coordinate all group, transient, and catering sales efforts to maximize revenue. Develop, recommend, and manage the annual budget, marketing, public relations, and sales programs to drive rates, occupancy, and food and beverage opportunities, ensuring revenue and profit goals are met. Actively conduct outside sales calls, lead sales tours, and entertain clients. Negotiate contracts and understand the details within to secure the best terms. Stay informed about market trends and revenue opportunities, adjusting strategies accordingly. Track and evaluate the performance of top accounts, identifying trends and forecasting future opportunities. Adhere to Dreamscape Hospitality's policies, sales standards, and performance metrics. Meet individual and team sales goals, as well as budget targets. Train hotel staff to recognize and seize sales opportunities, increasing occupancy and revenue. Work with the General Manager and Corporate HR to manage the hotel sales team, ensuring staff are hired, trained, developed, and motivated. Handle performance reviews, disciplinary actions, and team development. Supervise the Catering & Event Management Team to meet or exceed catering, food and beverage, and meeting room rental budgets. Gain comprehensive knowledge of hotel operations, including Sales, Food & Beverage, Front Office, and Reservations. Maintain a strong presence in the local community and industry organizations. Attend and lead meetings as required, providing ongoing training to staff. Foster professional relationships with marketing partners and internal departments. Travel weekly as required.

Overview: Renvio is looking for a Marketing Manager, Digital and Design to help shape how our brand shows up across digital channels, campaigns, sales materials, events, and our website. This is a hands-on marketing role for someone with strong creative instincts, a sharp eye for design, and the ability to turn strategy and ideas into execution. You will help manage Renvio's look and feel, support day-to-day digital and design needs, and make sure the company shows up with polish, consistency, and purpose. The right person for this role is ready to roll up their sleeves, build, design, improve, and help the marketing team get more great work out the door. What You'll Do: Manage Renvio's Look and Feel - You will help ensure Renvio shows up consistently and professionally across every major touchpoint, including the website, email, social media, collateral, presentations, digital ads, event materials, and sales enablement assets. Design marketing collateral, one-pagers, campaign assets, event materials, social graphics, email graphics, web visuals, presentations, and sales enablement materials. Take brand standards, campaign direction, messaging, and business priorities and turn them into clear, polished, on-brand creative. Help maintain consistency across Renvio's brand visuals, templates, colors, typography, and layouts. Improve existing assets so they feel more polished, modern, and useful. Create reusable templates and design systems that make it easier for the team to move quickly. Help the company show up well externally and internally. Own Website and Digital Design Execution - You will play an important role in managing and improving Renvio's digital presence, especially the website. This includes building and updating web pages, supporting landing pages, improving layouts, and helping ensure our digital experience is clear, usable, and aligned with our brand. Create and update website pages, landing pages, forms, event pages, and campaign pages. Design page layouts that support clear messaging and strong user experience. Work within website, CMS, marketing automation, and CRM tools. Help improve digital assets for clarity, conversion, and visual impact. Coordinate with vendors or agencies when technical support is needed. Make sure our digital presence stays current, clean, and aligned with business priorities. Support Campaigns, Emails, and Paid Media Creative - You will help the marketing team bring campaigns to life across digital channels. This includes designing email creative, campaign visuals, landing pages, paid media assets, and supporting materials. You will also help guide the creative work produced by outside partners, including agencies supporting paid advertising. Design campaign graphics and digital assets. Create visuals for marketing emails, newsletters, webinars, events, and nurture campaigns. Support paid ad creative by reviewing, guiding, and approving agency-developed concepts. Turn campaign strategy into practical creative assets. Help ensure campaign materials are on brand and easy to understand. Look at creative performance and help identify ways to improve assets over time. Turn Ideas Into Execution - A big part of this role is helping the marketing team move faster and produce more. You will take ideas, direction, copy sheets, campaign plans, and stakeholder requests and turn them into finished assets. Take a rough idea and turn it into a polished design. Work from copy provided by the marketing team and adjust it when needed to support the design without changing the intended message. Help organize and prioritize creative requests. Manage multiple projects at once. Keep work moving through reviews, edits, and approvals. Bring a practical, solutions-oriented mindset to the work. Support Events and Sales Enablement - You will help create materials that support events, webinars, conferences, and sales conversations. Event graphics and signage. Email and landing page creative for events. Booth and handout materials. Webinar graphics and promotional assets. Sales decks, one-pagers, leave-behinds, and other customer-facing materials. Internal templates and assets that help customer-facing teams represent Renvio well. Compensation: $75,000 annually, plus a competitive benefits package.

What are we doing? Medra's mission is to eradicate disease. What We're Building: We have been quietly building the foundational layers of our Physical AI Scientist platform: Physical AI that can operate scientific instruments with human-level dexterity. Scientific AI that can analyze results, reason about next steps, and close the loop autonomously. This is an incredibly ambitious mission, but we believe that a team of ambitious people with high ownership can accomplish incredible things. The Team: We're a team of passionate, mission-driven people from companies like Tesla, Applied Intuition, SpaceX, Neuralink, Scale, Samsara, and Vercel. We're collaborative and committed to moving fast with extreme prioritization. Our team is opinionated and straightforward. We don't mind intense discussions about tradeoffs. If we have arguments or miscommunication, we resolve conflicts quickly and empathetically. Feedback of all types is not just welcome, but expected. As a team, we're always looking for ways to grow and improve. We love learning new things and then sharing our new knowledge with each other. BizOps at Medra: This is a 0→1 role at the center of a company scaling fast. This is not a support role. You are the operational infrastructure the team runs on. Every system you build, every workflow you automate, every fire you put out makes the entire company faster. When something falls through the cracks, you're the person who notices, owns it, and ships a fix before anyone has to ask. We're a startup doing the work of a company five times our size. There are no established playbooks. If you're looking for defined processes and clear swim lanes, this isn't the right fit. If you see a room full of broken workflows, missing systems, and a half-built CRM and your first instinct is to start fixing things, keep reading. Responsibilities: Business Operations - Own day-to-day business operations and keep the company running while it scales. Process Improvement - Dig into cross-functional pain points, find root causes, and fix the underlying systems, not just the symptoms. You'll touch finance, hiring, customer success, and ops, often in the same week. Go-to-Market and Sales Support - Step into sales and GTM on short notice. Pitch decks, prospect pipelines, outbound messaging, collateral. Whatever the Sales/GTM/BD team needs to move faster. Automation and Systems - Build automations and kill manual work. You're AI-native and you treat every repetitive process as a problem to solve. Special Projects - Take on special projects that are high-value, loosely scoped, and need someone who can figure it out without being told how. Compensation Range: $90K - $140K

Job Overview: We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to support daily office operations. The ideal candidate will handle administrative tasks, manage schedules, maintain records, and ensure smooth communication within the organization. This role requires strong organizational, communication, and multitasking skills. Key Responsibilities: Provide administrative support to managers and team members. Manage calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate appointments. Prepare and edit documents, reports, and presentations. Answer phone calls, respond to emails, and handle correspondence. Maintain and organize office files, records, and databases. Coordinate office activities, meetings, and company events. Assist with travel arrangements and expense reports. Order and manage office supplies and equipment. Support HR or finance departments with basic administrative tasks when needed. Ensure office operations run smoothly and efficiently. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business administration or a related field. 1-3 years of experience in an administrative or office support role. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Excellent organizational and time-management abilities. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks effectively. Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Professional attitude and ability to maintain confidentiality. Salary: $75,000.00/yr - $95,000.00/yr. Benefits: Competitive salary, Health and medical benefits, Paid time off and public holidays, Professional development and training opportunities, Supportive and collaborative work environment, Opportunities for career advancement.

Company Description: CONCORDE co -- Manufacturers of SuperSonic Jet Airplanes. Role Description: This is a full-time on-site role for a Vice President of Business Development based in the United States of America, yet especially in the great cities of New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles, & Miami, as well as in International CONCORDE hubs, like Hong Kong, Riyadh, Singapore, Chengdu, Beijing, Xian, Canton, Mumbai, etc. The role involves selling airplanes, selling services, identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, leading strategic partnerships, creating business planning initiatives, making deals, recruiting, overseeing contract negotiation processes, and driving ticket sales efforts. The VP will also be responsible for fostering strong client relationships and managing key accounts, ensuring long-term growth and success for the company. Sales, sales, sales, is what the job is all about... SALES OF THREE TYPES OF SUPERSONIC AIRPLANES. Qualifications: Proven expertise in Sales, New Business Development and Business Planning. Strong skills in Contract Negotiation and Sales. Experience in Account Management with a focus on building and maintaining strong client relationships. Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. Analytical mindset with the ability to strategize and drive results. Company Description: La Dolce Vita Bespoke Interiors is a leading creator of luxury and high-performance interiors that combine Italian artistry, precision, and innovation. Known for redefining elegance, the company offers bespoke solutions that integrate craftsmanship with cutting-edge design. As the official partner of Lamborghini, La Dolce Vita brings unparalleled customization to interior spaces, incorporating unique materials such as forged composites, Italian leather, and illuminated shelving. Based in Miami, FL, the company specializes in complex interior projects, streamlining execution and delivering flawless results. Role Description: This is a full-time on-site role located in Miami, FL. As a Project Manager, you will oversee the end-to-end execution of complex interior design projects, ensuring seamless coordination among multiple teams. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing project timelines, ensuring quality standards, expediting work across different phases, inspecting progress, and overseeing logistics to deliver projects within set deadlines and budgets. You will be the single point of contact between clients, designers, and vendors, ensuring flawless execution and high-quality outcomes. Qualifications: Proven experience in Project Management, with the ability to effectively manage budgets, schedules, vendors, and teams. Strong knowledge of expediting processes to ensure timely delivery of materials, production, and project milestones. Familiarity with inspection protocols and quality control procedures to ensure compliance with project specifications and high-end standards. Expertise in logistics coordination, including supplier management, deliveries, and resource planning. Excellent communication, organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills. English and Spanish languages are required; Italian language is highly appreciated, but not mandatory. Experience in luxury interiors, high-end residential construction, cabinetry, millwork, or design industries is highly preferred. Proficiency in project management software and digital tools is appreciated, but not mandatory. Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field is appreciated, but not mandatory.

At Medtronic you can begin a life-long career of exploration and innovation, while helping champion healthcare access and equity for all. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world. A Day in the Life: As one of three comprehensive portfolios at Medtronic, Neuroscience is dedicated to improving the lives of people living with neurological disorders, spine conditions, and chronic pain. Guided by our Mission—to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life—we develop technologies and therapies that help people regain function, reduce pain, and return to the activities that matter most. Our Cranial & Spinal Technologies (CST) Operating Unit develops and delivers an integrated ecosystem of spinal implants, navigation and robotic guidance systems, advanced imaging, and data-driven planning tools for complex spine and cranial procedures. Platforms such as AiBLE™ connect these technologies to enhance surgical precision, streamline workflows, and support improved patient outcomes worldwide. The Clinical Research Specialist supports clinical evidence strategy across the product lifecycle, with a primary focus on leading New Product Innovation (NPI) clinical evidence generation activities and managing Post‑Market Clinical Follow‑up (PMCF) activities in accordance with EU MDR requirements. This is a strategy‑driven role, responsible for clinical evidence planning, execution, assessment, and documentation. The position does not perform day‑to‑day clinical operations but works closely with Clinical Operations and cross‑functional teams across the Cranial & Spinal Technologies (CST) operating unit to ensure clinical data collection activities are aligned with regulatory and business needs. Responsibilities: Lead clinical evidence strategy for the CST portfolio, including development and maintenance of Global Clinical Evidence Strategy (GCES) documentation aligned to business needs. Develop, maintain, and periodically revise PMCF Plans in accordance with EU MDR Annex XIV; assess evidence sufficiency and execute PMCF activities (surveys, registries, observational studies) to close identified gaps. Integrate PMCF outputs into CERs and related documentation; evaluate the impact of incremental product changes on PMCF strategy. Partner with Clinical Operations on PMCF study design, and with Medical Writing on CEPs, CERs, PMCFRs, and SSCPs. Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs, Quality, R&D, Medical Affairs, and Marketing on submissions, post-market assessments, and claims substantiation. Support responses to Notified Body and regulatory authority inquiries; support surgeon engagements as needed. Maintain strategic oversight of PMCF activities and ensure all documentation remains current, traceable, and audit-ready. Required Knowledge and Experience: Baccalaureate degree. Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, or an advanced degree with 0 years of experience. Salary Range: $83,200.00 - $124,800.00

The Credentialing Specialist is responsible for managing the credentialing and re-credentialing processes for healthcare providers to ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory standards. This role involves the verification of provider credentials, licenses, and professional qualifications, as well as maintaining accurate records and databases. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, and skilled in managing documentation and deadlines. Duties and Responsibilities: Credentialing & Re-credentialing - Conduct thorough credentialing and re-credentialing processes for new and existing providers, verifying qualifications, licenses, certifications, education, work history, and other relevant credentials. Ensure compliance with regulatory, accrediting, and internal requirements for credentialing documentation. Track and manage all credential expirations and renewals to maintain up-to-date provider files. Verification & Compliance - Verify credentials through primary source verification, including contacting educational institutions, licensing boards, and previous employers. Ensure credentialing activities adhere to standards set by accrediting bodies (e.g., NCQA, URAC, Joint Commission) and state/federal regulations. Identify and resolve any discrepancies or potential compliance risks during the credentialing process. Database & Record Maintenance - Maintain accurate provider information in credentialing databases and systems, ensuring records are current and organized. Track credentialing status, license expirations, and renewals, and document updates in the database. Regularly audit credentialing files to ensure compliance with policies and maintain a high standard of record accuracy. Communication & Coordination - Act as the main point of contact for providers during the credentialing process, answering questions, providing guidance, and offering status updates. Collaborate with internal teams, such as recruitment, HR, and medical staff services, to support a smooth onboarding and credentialing process. Communicate effectively with external organizations, including licensing boards, educational institutions, and accreditation agencies, for timely verifications. Reporting & Documentation - Prepare and maintain reports on credentialing metrics, such as application status, processing times, and compliance rates. Document all credentialing activities, communications, and decisions in line with regulatory requirements and company standards. Assist in updating credentialing policies and procedures to improve processes and ensure compliance. Qualifications: Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or related field. 2+ years of experience in credentialing, medical staff services, or a related role in a healthcare setting. Knowledge of credentialing standards (NCQA, URAC, Joint Commission) and federal and state regulations. Excellent attention to detail, organizational, and time-management skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Salary: $65,000

About SonderMind: At SonderMind, we believe everyone deserves one personalized, connected, and effective mental health destination to take care of their mental health and well-being at any stage of life. SonderMind care encompasses everything from therapy and medication management to meditation and mindfulness exercises. Our clinicians leverage our digital tools and research to deliver increasingly high-quality care and to develop thriving practices. Combining technology and human connection, SonderMind drives better outcomes through our comprehensive approach. About The Role: As our ideal candidate, you are passionate about our company mission and are able to channel that energy into supporting and motivating providers to grow their business. Exceeding retention & growth performance expectations motivates you given that you are directly contributing to redesigning behavioral health as you support and grow high quality providers. What you'll do: Successfully manage a caseload of 2,000 providers to grow their business with SonderMind, inclusive of dormant, steady and high growth providers. Proactively identify areas for providers to grow their caseloads, increase performance metrics and retain their relationships with SonderMind. Collaboratively develop innovative solutions for encouraging providers to choose SonderMind as their partner of choice. And other responsibilities and ad-hoc projects from time to time based on business needs. What does success look like? Meet or exceed monthly growth performance goals (defined quarterly). Retain assigned provider caseload. Ensure working with providers to meet SonderMind billing and clinical expectations i.e. closely manage aging claims and work with clinical quality team to address compliance issues. Performance will be measured quarterly to ensure pacing towards targets. Who You Are: Experience working with a high-volume of inbound inquiries, external outreach, and a large number of relationships. Self-starter, takes initiative and adapts to changing demands. Brings a positive and professional attitude to work every day. Growth mindset, always ready to learn and apply new strategies or approaches. Superior attention to detail and time management skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Experience utilizing data to drive insight and action. Experience with a CRM software (Salesforce preferred). Experience working for a high growth company (healthcare industry preferred). Comfortable navigating difficult situations with customers. Base Salary: $60,000. Total cash compensation (base + commission): $75,000.
